newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Landcorp reports fall in first half profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Landcorp reports fall in first half profit.

text.p: New Zealand's state-owned Land Corporation Ltd on Friday reported net profit after tax and minority interests of $2.2 million for the six months to December 31, down from $8.7 million in the previous corresponding period.

Landcorp Investments Ltd made further progress in realising its remaining land and loan assets. Total half-year earnings, including realised and unrealised changes in asset values, were $5.0 million, down from $12.7 million a year earlier.
Provision has been made to pay the government an interim dividend of $4.0 million on March 15, versus $13.0 million a year earlier.

"Net operating results for the full year are expected to be a little better than budgeted before the start of the season but are still very much affected by the current unsatisfactory wool and cattle prices in particular," Landcorp said.
